summary: The Special Planes are cosmic anomalies that defy conventional planar structure. Time, Underfoot, Discord, and the Void each represent unique metaphysical forces that shape reality.

events: Time formed as a nonlinear realm outside conventional space.
Underfoot emerged as the domain of Brell Serilis.
Discord manifested as a hostile realm of corruption and war.
The Void appeared as a null-space consuming planar energy.
Gods established limited influence over Time and Underfoot.
Temporal fractures connected Time to Norrath.
The Void expanded, consuming planar fragments.
Mortals entered Time, Discord, and Underfoot.
